tafsir.title: Al-Hamdu Lillah
tafsir.commentary: Every good matter begins with praising Allah. This surah is called Umm al-Kitab (Mother of the Book). It is obligatory in every rakah of prayer and encapsulates the entire essence of Islamic monotheism, worship, and supplication.

tafsir.title: Rabb al-Alamin
tafsir.commentary: Allah begins by praising Himself, the highest form of praise. Rabb means the One who nurtures, sustains, and governs all creation. Al-Alamin encompasses every realm of existence.

tafsir.title: Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim
tafsir.commentary: Ar-Rahman is the vast, all-encompassing mercy extending to all creation. Ar-Rahim is the specific mercy reserved for the believers in the Hereafter. Ar-Rahman is unique to Allah while Ar-Rahim could also describe a merciful person.

tafsir.title: Maliki yawm ad-Din
tafsir.commentary: This ayah mentions Allahs absolute sovereignty over the Day of Judgment, when all creation will be gathered. No one will have any authority except Allah. Malik denotes absolute ownership and dominion.

tafsir.title: Iyyaka nabudu wa iyyaka nastaain
tafsir.commentary: Worship combines love, fear, and hope. You alone we worship establishes monotheism, while You alone we ask for help affirms complete dependence on Allah. Together they form the foundation of the Islamic creed.

tafsir.title: Ihdina as-Sirat al-Mustaqim
tafsir.commentary: The straight path is Islam. The Jews earned anger by hiding the truth and the Christians went astray by exceeding bounds. This supplication asks for steadfastness until death.

tafsir.title: Sirat al-Ladhina anamta alayhim
tafsir.commentary: Those Allah favored include the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous. The anger is divine wrath that settles permanently. Going astray means wandering without guidance.

tafsir.title: Dhalika al-Kitab
tafsir.commentary: The first ayah revealed in Madinah. The Quran is guidance for the muttaqin. There is no doubt in it for those who reflect.

tafsir.title: Made the earth a resting place
tafsir.commentary: Allah made the earth stable, placed rivers and mountains, and provided fruits in pairs. A sign for those who reflect.

tafsir.title: How can you disbelieve?
tafsir.commentary: Allah reminds: you were lifeless, then He gave you life, then He will cause you to die, then bring you back. Recognize His power and do not deny the Resurrection.

tafsir.title: I am placing a khalifah on earth
tafsir.commentary: When Allah told the angels, Iblis objected. Allah responded: I know what you do not know. The khalifah is Adam and his descendants, honored with knowledge and authority.

tafsir.title: Glory be to You, we have no knowledge
tafsir.commentary: The angels acknowledged their limitations. True knowledge comes from Allah alone. When Adam was taught the names, the angels were humbled.

tafsir.title: Whoever follows My guidance
tafsir.commentary: Whoever follows guidance will not go astray or be miserable. Sincere adherence leads to success; turning away brings misery.

tafsir.title: To Allah belong the east and the west
tafsir.commentary: Wherever you turn, the Face of Allah is there. All directions are equal in His presence. The qiblah remained a test of sincerity.

tafsir.title: Thus We made you a middle nation
tafsir.commentary: Allah made the ummah wasat (moderate) in all affairs. The change of qiblah tested who truly followed the Messenger.

tafsir.title: To each a direction they face
tafsir.commentary: Each community has its direction. So compete in good deeds. The competition should be in righteousness.

tafsir.title: Remember Me, and I will remember you
tafsir.commentary: One of the most beautiful promises. If you remember Allah through obedience, He will remember you with reward and care.

tafsir.title: We will surely test you
tafsir.commentary: Allah tests through fear, hunger, loss of wealth, lives, and crops. Give good tidings to the patient who say: To Allah we belong and to Him we shall return.

tafsir.title: Righteousness is not in turning your faces
tafsir.commentary: True righteousness: believing in Allah, the Last Day, the angels, the Books, the prophets; giving wealth to the needy; establishing prayer and giving zakah.

tafsir.title: Fasting has been prescribed for you
tafsir.commentary: Fasting was prescribed so you may attain taqwa. It purifies the soul and body, develops gratitude, and teaches self-control.

tafsir.title: The month of Ramadan
tafsir.commentary: Ramadan is when the Quran was revealed as guidance. Whoever witnesses it should fast. Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months.

tafsir.title: When My servants ask you about Me
tafsir.commentary: Allah is near and responds to supplications: I am near. I respond to the call of the caller when he calls upon Me.

tafsir.title: Fighting has been enjoined upon you
tafsir.commentary: Jihad is prescribed even though you dislike it. You may hate a thing good for you and love a thing bad for you. Allah knows and you do not.

tafsir.title: Ayat al-Kursi - The Throne Verse
tafsir.commentary: The greatest ayah in the Quran. Allah is the Eternal, the Sustainer. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. His Kursi extends over the heavens and earth. Reciting it before sleep is a protection.

tafsir.title: The example of those who spend
tafsir.commentary: Their wealth is like a grain producing seven ears, each with a hundred grains. Allah multiplies the reward. Charity increases wealth through barakah.

tafsir.title: He gives wisdom to whom He wills
tafsir.commentary: Wisdom is understanding the Quran and Sunnah correctly. It is given by Allah. None remember except those of understanding.

tafsir.title: The longest verse - recording debts
tafsir.commentary: The longest verse in the Quran, detailing rules for recording debts with witnesses. Fear Allah appears at both beginning and end, framing transactions in piety.

tafsir.title: Allah does not burden a soul
tafsir.commentary: Every person receives only what they can bear. Good and evil deeds are recorded. The Prophet will intercede. A source of comfort for every struggling believer.

tafsir.title: Let not our hearts deviate
tafsir.commentary: The believers pray for steadfastness after guidance. The heart can deviate even after receiving it, hence the constant need for divine assistance.

tafsir.title: Allah is my Lord and your Lord
tafsir.commentary: Isa declared monotheism explicitly, rejecting divinity being attributed to him. His mission was to guide people to worship one God.

tafsir.title: The example of Isa
tafsir.commentary: Isa before Allah is like Adam - He created him from dust and said Be, and he was. If Adam had no father, Isa without a father is within Allahs power.

tafsir.title: Ibrahim was not a Jew nor a Christian
tafsir.commentary: Ibrahim was a pure monotheist (hanif), a Muslim. His creed is the foundation of Islam.

tafsir.title: Whoever seeks other than Islam
tafsir.commentary: No other religion is accepted by Allah. Islam is submission to Allah alone through His prophets.

tafsir.title: Do not weaken and do not grieve
tafsir.commentary: After Uhud, Allah commanded not to weaken. You will be superior if you are true believers.

tafsir.title: Every soul will taste death
tafsir.commentary: Every soul tastes death. Whoever is drawn from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has succeeded. The life of this world is delusion.

tafsir.title: In the creation of the heavens and the earth
tafsir.commentary: The scholars contemplate the signs of Allah. They reflect: Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose. This is the highest worship through contemplation.

tafsir.title: O mankind, be conscious of your Lord
tafsir.commentary: Created from one soul. From it He created its mate. The highest status is through taqwa, not lineage.

tafsir.title: Men are the protectors of women
tafsir.commentary: Men are guardians by virtue of what Allah gave and their spending. Righteous women are obedient. For disobedience: admonish, separate, then discipline gently.

tafsir.title: Obey Allah and the Messenger
tafsir.commentary: Obey Allah, the Messenger, and those in authority. If you differ, refer to Allah and the Messenger.

tafsir.title: Be persistently standing firm in justice
tafsir.commentary: Be witnesses for Allah even against yourselves, parents, or relatives. Justice is closer to taqwa.

tafsir.title: Forbidden foods - comprehensive dietary laws
tafsir.commentary: Dead meat, blood, swine flesh, what is slaughtered for other than Allah, strangling, violent blow, fall, goring, wild animal kills. Exceptions for travelers in necessity.

tafsir.title: Intoxicants, gambling, and altars
tafsir.commentary: Defilement from Shaytan. Avoid them to be successful. Shaytan seeks enmity and to divert from prayer.

tafsir.title: No creature moves except they are communities
tafsir.commentary: All creatures are communities like you. Nothing is neglected in the Book.

tafsir.title: With Him are the keys of the unseen
tafsir.commentary: No one knows the unseen except Allah. Not a leaf falls except He knows it.

tafsir.title: That is Allah, your Lord
tafsir.commentary: No deity except Him, the Creator of all things. Worship Him.

tafsir.title: O Children of Adam
tafsir.commentary: Take clean clothes at every masjid. Eat and drink but do not be excessive.

tafsir.title: The major sins
tafsir.commentary: Indecency, sin, transgression, shirk without authority, and saying about Allah what you do not know.

tafsir.title: The true believers
tafsir.commentary: Hearts tremble when Allah is mentioned, faith increases with His verses, trust in their Lord, establish prayer, and spend.

tafsir.title: Allah has purchased
tafsir.commentary: Allah purchased from believers their lives and wealth for Paradise. They fight, kill, and are killed.

tafsir.title: The Quran is healing
tafsir.commentary: An instruction and healing for what is in the breasts - guidance and mercy for believers.

tafsir.title: Yaqubs dream
tafsir.commentary: Eleven stars, the sun, and the moon bowing. Prophecy of Yusufs future station despite his brothers jealousy.

tafsir.title: Reunion with family
tafsir.commentary: Yusuf raised his parents to the throne and brothers bowed. He attributed all to Allah.

tafsir.title: In their stories there is a lesson
tafsir.commentary: The Quran is not fabricated but a confirmation and detailed explanation, guidance and mercy.

tafsir.title: In the remembrance of Allah do hearts find tranquility
tafsir.commentary: The restlessness of the soul is only removed through the remembrance of Allah.

tafsir.title: If you are grateful, I will increase you
tafsir.commentary: Gratitude is not merely verbal but includes using blessings in obedience. The promise of increase is beautiful.

tafsir.title: Allah commands justice
tafsir.commentary: Justice, good conduct, giving to relatives. Forbids immorality, bad conduct, oppression. A summary of Islamic ethics.

tafsir.title: Honor your parents
tafsir.commentary: After monotheism, honoring parents is the first command. The mother carried with hardship, weaning in two years.

tafsir.title: Establish the five daily prayers
tafsir.commentary: From decline of sun (Dhuhr) to darkness of night (Asr, Maghrib, Isha), and Fajr recitation.

tafsir.title: The Quran was revealed in stages
tafsir.commentary: Over 23 years for reflection and absorption at intervals.

tafsir.title: The People of the Cave
tafsir.commentary: They prayed for mercy. Allah gave them 309 years of sleep. Persecution brings miraculous protection.

tafsir.title: Moses and Al-Khidr
tafsir.commentary: Three incidents with hidden wisdom: broken ship, killed boy, repaired wall. Divine wisdom transcends human comprehension.

tafsir.title: If the sea were ink
tafsir.commentary: The sea would be exhausted before Allahs words. His knowledge is infinite.

tafsir.title: I am only a human like you
tafsir.commentary: The Prophet declares his humanity and clear monotheism. No divinity is attributed to him.

tafsir.title: The birth of Isa
tafsir.commentary: Allah sent Jibril to Maryam. She feared, but Allah reassured her and gave her Isa without a father as a sign.

tafsir.title: Indeed, I am your Lord
tafsir.commentary: Moses at the fire in the sacred valley of Tuwa - the beginning of his prophethood.

tafsir.title: Expand for me my breast
tafsir.commentary: Musa prayed for ease of heart, solving his speech, and an assistant. Even prophets seek Allahs help.

tafsir.title: The heavens and earth were joined
tafsir.commentary: The cosmic origins of the universe. Water made the basis of all life - confirmed by modern science.

tafsir.title: The scales of justice
tafsir.commentary: On Judgment Day, scales will ensure no soul is wronged, even by a mustard seed.

tafsir.title: Successful are the believers
tafsir.commentary: Humble in prayer, avoiding idle talk, giving zakah, guarding chastity, keeping trusts.

tafsir.title: Stages of creation
tafsir.commentary: Drop, alaqah, mudghah, bones, flesh. Described 1400 years ago, confirmed by modern science.

tafsir.title: Lower your gaze
tafsir.commentary: For both men and women. The Islamic code of modesty starts with the eyes as gateway to the heart.

tafsir.title: The hijab verse
tafsir.commentary: Women should not display adornment except what normally appears, drawing coverings over chests.

tafsir.title: Mates for you - tranquility and mercy
tafsir.commentary: Among His signs: mates for tranquility, affection, and mercy. Marriage is one of the greatest signs.

tafsir.title: The fitrah
tafsir.commentary: Direct your face to the religion. The natural disposition upon which Allah created mankind cannot be altered.

tafsir.title: Luqmans advice
tafsir.commentary: Do not associate partners with Allah. Be dutiful to parents. Know Allah will take account.

tafsir.title: Establish prayer, enjoin good
tafsir.commentary: Comprehensive duties: prayer, promoting virtue, opposing vice, patience in hardship.

tafsir.title: Lower your voice
tafsir.commentary: The most disagreeable voice is a donkeys bray. Speak gently and moderately.

tafsir.title: An excellent example in the Messenger
tafsir.commentary: The Prophets conduct is the supreme model for all believers.

tafsir.title: Allah and His angels send blessings
tafsir.commentary: O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet with peace.

tafsir.title: The hijab for believing women
tafsir.commentary: Bring down outer garments. This established the hijab linking modesty with protection.

tafsir.title: Ibrahim and the sacrifice
tafsir.commentary: Ibrahim submitted to sacrifice his son. Allah replaced it with a ram. The highest level of submission.

tafsir.title: Inheritance shares
tafsir.commentary: Male receives two females share. Two daughters get two-thirds. One daughter gets half. Clear divine rights.

tafsir.title: Most people are disbelievers
tafsir.commentary: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they.

tafsir.title: Fight for the oppressed
tafsir.commentary: Why not fight for those who cry out: Our Lord, deliver us from oppressors? Defending the oppressed is obligatory.

tafsir.title: The Kaaba
tafsir.commentary: Made a place of return and security. Ibrahim and Ismail purified it for worshippers.

tafsir.title: Ibrahim prayed for a Messenger
tafsir.commentary: His supplication was answered with Prophet Muhammad.

tafsir.title: No distinction between Messengers
tafsir.commentary: Belief in all prophets without differentiation - the foundational creed.

tafsir.title: Spend in the cause of Allah
tafsir.commentary: Do not be stingy. Charity includes all forms of righteous expenditure.

tafsir.title: Menstruation rulings
tafsir.commentary: A natural condition with clear rules. Purification before approaching.

tafsir.title: The waiting period
tafsir.commentary: Three menstrual cycles for divorced women. Allows reflection and reconciliation.

tafsir.title: Breastfeeding rights
tafsir.commentary: Two complete years if father wishes. Both parents share the cost.

tafsir.title: Allah borrows from you
tafsir.commentary: Charity is a loan to Allah with multiplied reward. He elevates His servants through generosity.

tafsir.title: The test of the river
tafsir.commentary: Saul tested the believers. Those who drank merely a handful proved sincere.

tafsir.title: Do not nullify charity
tafsir.commentary: Give purely for Allahs sake, not for show or to harm others.

tafsir.title: Whatever you spend
tafsir.commentary: Allah knows every intention, public or secret.

tafsir.title: Those who spend wealth
tafsir.commentary: Not diminished but multiplied. No fear or grief. The highest sincerity.

tafsir.title: To Allah belongs all
tafsir.commentary: He will call you to account for what you conceal. He forgives and punishes as He wills.

tafsir.title: The Messengers creed
tafsir.commentary: Belief in all prophets without distinction.

tafsir.title: Respond to Allah urgently
tafsir.commentary: When He calls you to what gives you life. Death can come at any moment.

tafsir.title: The Quran is a healing
tafsir.commentary: An instruction and mercy for believers. Healing for diseases of the heart.

tafsir.title: Establish prayer
tafsir.commentary: Good deeds remove evil deeds. A reminder for those who remember.

tafsir.title: Remembrance brings tranquility
tafsir.commentary: Hearts find peace only through the remembrance of Allah.

tafsir.title: Gratitude brings increase
tafsir.commentary: If grateful, He increases blessings. If ungrateful, punishment is severe.

tafsir.title: The ethical summary
tafsir.commentary: Justice, good conduct, giving to relatives. Forbids immorality and oppression.

tafsir.title: Strive in the cause of Allah
tafsir.commentary: He chose you and placed no difficulty. He named you Muslims.

tafsir.title: The Criterion
tafsir.commentary: The Quran distinguishes truth from falsehood, guidance from misguidance.

tafsir.title: Do not think you will be left alone
tafsir.commentary: Faith is tested. Those before you were tested. Allah makes truth evident.

tafsir.title: Prayer prohibits immorality
tafsir.commentary: Prayer purifies the soul and prevents sin.

tafsir.title: Ibrahim's submission
tafsir.commentary: The highest example of surrender to Allah's command.

tafsir.title: O Dawud, judge with justice
tafsir.commentary: Do not follow desire, for it will lead you astray.

tafsir.title: Creation of heavens and earth is greater
tafsir.commentary: Greater than creation of mankind, yet most do not reflect.

tafsir.title: We will show Our signs
tafsir.commentary: In the horizons and within themselves, until the truth becomes clear.

tafsir.title: One religion for all prophets
tafsir.commentary: Prescribed for Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, and Isa. Maintain religion without division.

tafsir.title: Kindness to parents
tafsir.commentary: The mother carried with hardship. Be grateful to Me and to your parents.

tafsir.title: The description of Paradise
tafsir.commentary: Rivers of water, milk, wine, and purified honey. Purified spouses forever.

tafsir.title: Nations and tribes for mutual recognition
tafsir.commentary: The most noble have the most taqwa. Knowledge does not elevate over righteousness.

tafsir.title: Faith has not yet entered your hearts
tafsir.commentary: Say We have submitted. Faith requires more than verbal claim.

tafsir.title: Closer than the jugular vein
tafsir.commentary: Allah records what is before and behind. His knowledge is intimate and total.

tafsir.title: Created to worship
tafsir.commentary: The fundamental purpose of human existence.

tafsir.title: The foremost in Paradise
tafsir.commentary: Brought near to Allah in Gardens of Delight.

tafsir.title: The First and the Last
tafsir.commentary: The Manifest and the Hidden. Knowledge of all things.

tafsir.title: Allah raises those with knowledge
tafsir.commentary: In degrees. Knowledge elevates the believers rank.

tafsir.title: Beautiful Names of Allah
tafsir.commentary: The Creator, Originator, Bestower of forms. To Him belong the most beautiful names.

tafsir.title: Be righteous toward peaceful people
tafsir.commentary: Allah does not forbid kindness and justice toward those who do not fight you.

tafsir.title: Isa foretold Ahmad
tafsir.commentary: Isa announced the coming of a Messenger named Ahmad (Muhammad).

tafsir.title: Friday prayer
tafsir.commentary: When the call is made, hasten to remembrance of Allah. Leave trade - it is better for you.

tafsir.title: Trust in Allah
tafsir.commentary: Whoever fears Allah, He will make a way out and provide from unexpected sources.

tafsir.title: Protect families from the Fire
tafsir.commentary: O you who believe, protect yourselves and families. Fuel is people and stones.

tafsir.title: Blessed is He with dominion
tafsir.commentary: He created death and life to test which of you is best in deed.

tafsir.title: When punishment approaches
tafsir.commentary: The disbelievers faces will be distressed. This is what you called for.

tafsir.title: Great moral character
tafsir.commentary: The divine testimony of the Prophets moral excellence.

tafsir.title: The word of an honored Messenger
tafsir.commentary: Not the word of a poet. The divine origin of the Quran.

tafsir.title: Except those who pray
tafsir.commentary: Constant in prayer, giving to the needy.

tafsir.title: Why do you not fear Allah
tafsir.commentary: The universal pattern of prophetic rejection.

tafsir.title: Among the jinn are Muslims
tafsir.commentary: Some submitted, some deviated. Righteousness brings guidance.

tafsir.title: Stand in prayer at night
tafsir.commentary: The voluntary night prayer as a means of drawing closer to Allah.

tafsir.title: Arise and warn
tafsir.commentary: Among the first revelations commanding the public mission.

tafsir.title: You love the immediate
tafsir.commentary: Prefer lasting reward over instant gratification.

tafsir.title: We guided him to the way
tafsir.commentary: Whether grateful or ungrateful, the choice rests with each person.

tafsir.title: By the winds sent forth
tafsir.commentary: Natural phenomena as signs of the coming Day of Judgment.

tafsir.title: In scorching wind and smoke
tafsir.commentary: The punishment described in graphic detail as a warning.

tafsir.title: Who plan with determination
tafsir.commentary: Divine promises never fail.

tafsir.title: He frowned and turned away
tafsir.commentary: No one should be considered less important in matters of guidance.

tafsir.title: When the pages are spread
tafsir.commentary: People will know what they brought. Certainty of accountability.

tafsir.title: What has deceived you concerning your Lord
tafsir.commentary: Reflect on your origin. You were created, proportioned, and balanced.

tafsir.title: Woe to those who give less
tafsir.commentary: Prohibition of cheating in measurements and business.

tafsir.title: Oft-Returning, the Merciful
tafsir.commentary: Despite warnings, Allahs ultimate attribute is mercy.

tafsir.title: We will make you recite
tafsir.commentary: The Prophets memorization of the Quran was divinely guaranteed.

tafsir.title: Look at the camels
tafsir.commentary: How they are created. Natural phenomena as signs of the Creator.

tafsir.title: You are only a reminder
tafsir.commentary: The Prophets role is to convey. Acceptance is in Allahs hands.

tafsir.title: O reassured soul, return to your Lord
tafsir.commentary: One of the most beautiful addresses to the righteous soul at death.

tafsir.title: With hardship comes ease
tafsir.commentary: Repeated emphasis: relief is guaranteed after every hardship.

tafsir.title: Created in the best of stature
tafsir.commentary: Then reduced to the lowest. Dignity and potential degradation through choices.

tafsir.title: Read in the name of your Lord
tafsir.commentary: The first revelation. Knowledge and reading are the foundation of faith.

tafsir.title: The Night of Decree
tafsir.commentary: Better than a thousand months. The Quran was sent down during it.

tafsir.title: Worship Allah alone
tafsir.commentary: The correct religion: sincere worship, establishing prayer, giving zakah.

tafsir.title: Seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
tafsir.commentary: The final surah. Protection from the evil whisperer through seeking Allahs refuge.
